label: Title
description:
Primary Title - Main title used to identify and display the asset, e.g., Portrait of a Young Woman
Alternate Title - Alternative or variant title, e.g., Young Woman Portrait
Determination - Used for taxon records where title does not apply
displaySpec:
1 - Title displays as it is in source system(CMS)
2 - This is mandatory data; CCS cannot display a record without a title

label: Object Type
description: Broad type of collection asset represented by the record
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Date
encompasses: Display values- Earliest, latest dates - Date collected - Created Period
description:
Date or date range when the asset was produced
Created period -> Named historical or cultural period
displaySpec:
1 - If 'display value' is available, CCS will display as-is
2 - If 'date collected' is available, CCS will display as-is
3 - Only when year is available, the system will add month and year for search purposes
4 - Use creator's life dates when asset dates are not available
examples:
c. 1920 
Middle Ages or Ming Dynasty

label: Creator
encompasses:
Primary Creator; Primary Creator Role; Secondary Creator; Secondary Creator Role; Party Name; Party Type; Date of Birth; Date of Death; organisation name

Skin Name; Language; Clan; Artist Location; Country; Father's Country; Grandmother's Country; Moiety; Mother's Country; Region; Totem;
description: Person or organisation responsible for creating the asset, e.g., John Longstaff
displaySpec: 1 - Creator can be person or organisation (which is association)

label: Associated Entity
description: Other people, organisations or groups associated with the asset.
displaySpec:
1 - Display order will be <Org name (DoB - DoD), role>
2 - When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Place
encompasses: L1, L2, L3, L4, L5 of Place - Collection Site, Place title
description: Place where the asset was produced, e.g., Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
displaySpec:
1 - Each availale value will be displayed with a comma
2 - When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear
questions:
tbd - Place has "Value" - Emu has a Value for each level (up to 5) and Vernon shows concatenated levels (in the Value field but a single instance)
RG - There is also place title which is useful for the users - eg: Old Quad Building

label: Description
description: Descriptive or interpretive text about the asset
displaySpec: To display just the brief intro text (2-3 lines) - Need ux input

label: Series
description: Series or other hierarchical grouping to which the asset belongs
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Editions
description: Links to related editions of the asset
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Material
description: Materials and/or techniques used, e.g., Oil on canvas
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Measurements (previosly mentioned as Dimensions)
encompasses: Measures - Height, width, depth, diameter, weights, units, display value and extent (Eg; archives)
description: Physical or technical measurements
displaySpec: 1 - The information displayed on CCS will depend on the data available in source system

label: Inscription
description: Inscription, signature, label or other text recorded on the asset
displaySpec:
1 - Multiple inscriptions should be displayed by inscription type:
2 - Each Inscription type will be identified by 'inscription type' and list of inscriptions separated by comma
3 - When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear
examples:
Signatures; signature 1, signature 2
Inscriptions: inscription 1, inscription 2
questions:
MDHS has signatures, inscriptions etc - MDHS has two fields (free text and table) where this data is stored. CCS needs to map both and display as-is.
FEIT has primary and secondary

label: Language
description: Language of the asset or its content, e.g., English
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Cultural Affiliation
description: Name of the affiliation of the asset, e.g., Wurundjeri Woi-wurrung
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Accession Number
description: Accession or catalogue number, e.g., 1987.0043
displaySpec:
1 - Accession number displays as it is in source system(CMS)
2 - This is mandatory data; CCS cannot display a record

label: Copyright
description: Copyright statement
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Credit Line
description: Human-readable provenance or credit statement, e.g., Donated by the Smith family in 1954
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Named Collection
description: Named, donor or other recognised collection, e.g., Smith Bequest.
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Collection
description: Formal institutional collection, e.g., University Art Collection.
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Access
description: Access conditions or restrictions, e.g., Open access, On display
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Classification
description: Classification within a defined scheme, e.g., Furniture or Eucalyptus globulus
displaySpec: 1 - Primary and Secondary classification, when available, will be in a string (one line of text).

label: Subject
description: Topic, theme or concept represented by the asset, e.g., Military history
displaySpec: 1 - When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Source URL
description: Link to the asset in an existing or legacy collection browser.
displaySpec: 1 - The availability of the external systems (browsers) is out of scope for CCS (broken urls, websites are down etc)
examples:
Examples of inconsistency and unavailability of browsers:
1 - Malformed url supplied (e.g. htp:/example missing protocol, stray text)
2 - URL points to a broken/non-existent page (404)
3 - External site is unreachable/down

label: Related Record
displaySpec: 1 - When multiple values, CCS will list each value in separate lines
examples:
Parent - related record 1; 
Child - related record 3

label: Licence Type
description: Copyright, licence or permitted reuse information
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Advisory
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Terms of Use
description: New field in DAM to support the display of DA in CCS
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Producer
description: Person or organisation responsible for creating the digital asset
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear
